ReflectionMarsh_Text_Npc0.en: Everything here looks like another\nPOKéMON, before or after.
ReflectionMarsh_Text_Npc0.fr: Tout ici ressemble à un autre\nPOKéMON, avant ou après.

ReflectionMarsh_Text_Npc1.en: I caught an EEVEE here. It would\nnot stop looking at its reflection.
ReflectionMarsh_Text_Npc1.fr: J'ai attrapé un ÉVOLI ici. Il ne\ncessait de regarder son reflet.

ReflectionMarsh_Text_Radar0.en: I track rare POKéMON. Today my\nradar says...
ReflectionMarsh_Text_Radar0.fr: Je piste les POKéMON rares.\nAujourd'hui mon radar indique…

ReflectionMarsh_Text_Radar1.en: FEEBAS bites in the quiet water of\nthe POND OF CYCLES, by fishing.
ReflectionMarsh_Text_Radar1.fr: BARPAU mord dans l'eau calme de\nl'ÉTANG DES CYCLES, à la pêche.

ReflectionMarsh_Text_Radar2.en: AERODACTYL is sighted in the FOSSIL\nDIG, among the rocks.
ReflectionMarsh_Text_Radar2.fr: PTÉRA est repéré aux FOUILLES\nDE FOSSILES, parmi les rochers.

ReflectionMarsh_Text_Radar3.en: DRATINI hides under the water of\nthe POND and the TRADE DOCK.
ReflectionMarsh_Text_Radar3.fr: MINIDRACO se cache sous l'eau de\nl'ÉTANG et du QUAI D'ÉCHANGE.

ReflectionMarsh_Text_ReturnAsk.en: Ready to go back to the dock?

ReflectionMarsh_Text_Stay.en: Take your time. The tide can wait.
